title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Education for Software Developers: A Multivocal Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.23311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum computing threatens widely deployed public-key cryptography, making post-quantum cryptography (PQC) adoption a software engineering challenge. However, it remains unclear how well existing educational provision prepares software developers for secure PQC implementation and migration. We conducted a multivocal literature review of 8 research publications and 15 professional training offerings, examining competency coverage, practical software engineering tasks, pedagogical approaches, learner support, and evaluation. All 23 sources covered PQC foundations and algorithms, but coverage of practical software-engineering tasks was uneven. Our analysis identifies six gaps concerning developer focused evaluation, authentic software engineering tasks, task competency alignment, pedagogical design and learner support, security-focused assessment, and long term validation of learning outcomes and transfer. translated_title: 面向软件开发者的后量子密码学教育：一项多源文献综述
translated_abstract: 量子计算对广泛部署的公钥密码学构成威胁，使后量子密码学（PQC）的采用成为一项软件工程挑战。然而，现有的教育资源能在多大程度上帮助软件开发者安全地实现和迁移到PQC，目前仍不明确。我们对8篇研究论文和15个专业培训项目进行了多源文献综述，考察了能力覆盖范围、实际的软件工程任务、教学方法、学习者支持以及评估等维度。所有23个来源都涵盖了PQC基础和算法，但对实际软件工程任务的覆盖并不均衡。我们的分析识别出六个缺口：面向开发者的评估、真实的软件工程任务、任务与能力的一致性、教学设计与学习者支持、以安全为中心的考核，以及学习成果与迁移的长期验证。我们据此提出了相关建议。
tldr: 本文通过对8篇学术文献和15个专业培训项目的多源文献综述，系统评估了面向软件开发者的后量子密码学（PQC）教育现状，发现虽然所有来源均覆盖PQC基础与算法，但实际软件工程任务训练不均衡，并识别出六大教育缺口及相应改进建议。
en_tdlr: This multivocal literature review of 8 research publications and 15 professional training offerings shows that existing post-quantum cryptography education for software developers covers foundations and algorithms well, but identifies six gaps—including lack of authentic software engineering tasks, developer-focused evaluation, and long-term validation of learning outcomes—along with recommendations for improvement.
